name: OpenEMR API
tagline: Open-source electronic health records FHIR R4 and REST APIs
description: OpenEMR exposes FHIR R4 and standard REST APIs for electronic health records, patient data, appointments, and clinical workflows. Self-hosted; endpoints and credentials come from your own OpenEMR instance rather than a public multi-tenant SaaS. Suitable for EHR integrations, patient portals, and health-app backends.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 (SMART on FHIR / password grant variants per version); client registration in OpenEMR admin; Bearer access token on API requests. Self-hosted—no central API key service.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Open-source software; no vendor API metering—limits are your server capacity
pricing.paid_plans: Optional commercial support and hosting from third parties; core software free (GPL)

use_cases: search patients by name or identifier on an OpenEMR instance
read FHIR R4 Patient and Encounter resources
create or update appointments via OpenEMR REST APIs
integrate a patient portal with OpenEMR clinical data
export or sync EHR data for analytics workflows
